fact: Proclamation No. 1321/2024 was published in Federal Negarit Gazette No. 35 on 24 July 2024, enters into force on publication (Art. 70), and Art. 5 gives the Authority powers to enforce, issue enforcement notices and impose administrative fines.
title: Federal Negarit Gazette No. 35: Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024
publisher: Federal Negarit Gazette of the FDRE
